abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Public manifest maps target1/2/3 to 1IEP ABL kinase with STI-571, 3ERT ER-alpha LBD with 4-hydroxytamoxifen, and 1HVR HIV-1 protease with cyclic urea inhibitor. PDB inspection was limited to derived counts and residue/ligand summaries; no raw PDB contents copied. Target1: kinase, 2 chains, 548 residues, 4458 ATOM records, bound non-water HET name STI, 74 non-water HET atoms, hydrophobic/polar/aromatic ratios 0.427/0.518/0.146, span 79.06, pocket_confidence 1.0, pocket_box 24.54x30.0x30.0, sha256 prefix 577386b4b8bc. Target2: nuclear receptor, 1 chain, 247 residues, 1962 ATOM records, bound non-water HET name OHT, 29 non-water HET atoms, ratios 0.494/0.466/0.113, span 52.28, pocket_confidence 1.0, pocket_box 24.45x20.76x24.69, sha256 prefix 9810b43b6956. Target3: protease, 2 chains, 196 residues, 1826 ATOM records, non-water HET names CSO and XK2, 64 non-water HET atoms, ratios 0.480/0.388/0.061, span 45.59, pocket_confidence 1.0, pocket_box 30.0x30.0x30.0, sha256 prefix c8d3f238d326.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: All targets have bound non-water ligand records and high-confidence inferred pockets. Context supports target-conditioned comparison, but the known ligand classes differ substantially, so any molecular change must clear route validity and evaluator-risk checks per target.

detail.value: Risks: molecules are very lipophilic and highly aromatic/flat, so increases in MW, logP, ring count, route length, or heavy atom count are likely evaluator-risky. Treat baseline as valid fallback unless an alternative beats it without adding risk.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Explored two improvement paths using RDKit and local code. First, main.py target-conditioned one-row selector generated valid rows but underperformed baseline on offline_eval tier-0/tier-1 proxy: baseline mean 71.2536 versus selector alternative 70.7317, both with 0 failures, so that path was rejected. Second, swept the enumerated route-constrained pools and ranked candidates with offline_eval proxy while requiring no route issues, no risk flags, and strict evaluator-friendly descriptors. The best no-flag candidate was O=C(Nc1cc(-c2ccc3ncccc3c2)nc2cc(Cl)ccc12)c1ccc2cc(Br)ccc2c1, present in all three target-specific pools, route_len 205, MW 538.832, logP 8.271, TPSA 54.88, QED 0.2466, SA 2.309, rings 6, rotors 3, heavy atoms 35, reagent_depth 0. Exact route final product equals mol_smiles for all targets.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Offline_eval results: baseline tier-1 mean/min 71.2536/71.0011 with 0 failures; proxy-top tier-1 mean/min 74.0712/74.0712 with 0 failures. Optional tier-2 docking proxy: baseline mean/min 73.8286/57.196, proxy-top mean/min 75.9682/60.0712, both 0 failures. The proxy-top candidate is less lipophilic/heavy/complex than baseline and improves the local proxy on all targets, so it is a justified safe candidate change despite using the same molecule across distinct target classes.
